name: cockpit
description: Makes a Claude Code session's work visible: the running round of tool calls, a per-turn summary, a session timeline, the files each turn edited, and a guard for destructive tool calls.

roundTrace.title: Tool call round tracing
roundTrace.description: While a turn runs, show the current round of tool calls after the spinner; when it ends, add a short summary line with the calls per tool.

roundTraceMaxTools.title: Tools named in the summary
roundTraceMaxTools.description: How many tool names the summary line lists, most used first. The rest are counted as +k more.

timeline.title: Timeline pane
timeline.description: Keep a row per turn (prompt, tool calls, tokens, time, edited files) and add the /cockpit command that opens it in a pane.

timelineAutoOpen.title: Open the timeline pane at start
timelineAutoOpen.description: Open the timeline pane when each session starts, instead of waiting for /cockpit. A pane opened this way waits on a terminal narrower than 144 columns (110 once you have opened it yourself) until the terminal widens or you run /cockpit.

editedFiles.title: Edited files band
editedFiles.description: After each turn in a git repository, show above the prompt which files the turn changed and by how many lines. Outside a git repository nothing is shown.

gate.title: Tool guard
gate.description: Refuse clearly destructive tool calls (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, file writes outside the project), plus any deny rules in your rules file. Every decision is logged and kept in an audit trail.

gateAutoModePrompt.title: Ask when auto mode blocks a call
gateAutoModePrompt.description: When the auto mode classifier blocks a tool call, ask whether to run it once anyway. Only in auto mode; Claude Code's own permission prompts are never asked twice.

gateRulesFile.title: Guard rules file
gateRulesFile.description: Your rules file: deny and allow rules, built-in rules to turn off, extra writable directories. A project's .claude/cockpit-rules.json can only add deny rules.

gateDisabledRules.title: Built-in guard rules to turn off
gateDisabledRules.description: Any of rm-rf, git-reset-hard, git-push-force, write-outside-project.
